lines.speaker: sora_op_r
lines.text: Attack incoming!

lines.speaker: sky_op_c
lines.text: Emergency evasive maneuvers!

lines.speaker: cielo_op_l
lines.text: Incoming on port side! Shield!

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Got it!

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: There it goes charging up again.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Snow White!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: On it!
A flurry of red lights shoot from the Goddess of Victory statue toward the Wings of Victory.
The ship abruptly changes its trajectory and evades in the direction with the fewest beams of light. However, it's impossible to dodge them all.
Before any of them can strike the port side, Rapunzel creates a shield and blocks them.
As the ship briefly stops, red light begins to gather around the statue's neck again.
Dorothy and Snow White attack the place where the light is gathering.
The statue shakes, and the light scatters.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Now...!
Marian raises her hand, creating an enormous black spear.
She sends it flying, hitting the statue precisely in the neck before dispersing and spraying Dark Matter.
There's a crunching sound as the Dark Matter quickly solidifies.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Oh! Didst thou empoison it with thine attack?

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Something like that. I made it harden to buy us some time.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: The field of gravity affects not thy spears.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: That's right. They're made of compressed, high-density Dark Matter, which makes them incredibly heavy.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Then I offer this stratagem. I shall ride upon a spear to engage our foe at sword's length. What sayest thee?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: I know you've been itching to dive into the action, but don't do it.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: But observe, I pray thee.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Doth not the same scene unfold before our eyes, again and yet again?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Hmm...
As Scarlet pointed out, the direction of the battle hasn't changed for a while.
The Wings of Victory wanders near the statue, attacking it.
The statue is damaged but immediately recovers.
The statue attacks the ship unceasingly, while the ship avoids its attacks using shields and evasive maneuvers.
Whenever the statue gets an opening, it starts to charge its enormous beam,
but the second the Nikkes see a hint of light starting to gather, they attack the neck and stop it.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: ... The same pattern does keep repeating.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Neither side is gaining or losing ground.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Something needs to give.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Thou speakest my mind. We require a means to turn the tide of battle, for which none serve the turn greater than I.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: A secret weapon. A hidden shaft in the quiver. Something of that nature.
During the battle, they witnessed two Heretics coming out from the Goddess of Victory statue.
They also saw a numberless throng of Nayutas pour out from it.
However, they had no time to worry about it. The statue immediately begins to charge its beam every chance it gets.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: ... Agh, the more I think about it, the more that damned thing seems to just be swatting at us like we're a pest while it focuses on the Ark.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Does it have some sort of infinite power supply? It keeps shooting lasers and regenerating without any sign of slowing down.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: This isn't working. Even if it's a bit reckless, we need to turn the tide.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Scarlet. Get ready.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Oho. Say no more.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Do whatever it takes to get Scarlet to the Goddess of Victo... wait, what am I saying? That's not the Goddess of Victory statue. Tch.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Do whatever it takes to get Scarlet on top of that thing.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Dorothy, don't hold back. Keep firing.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: What? Are you scared that if you use your full Heretic powers, you won't be able to come back as a Nikke?

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: I can't say I'm not.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Oh, come on. Don't worry about that.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: He's right. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Even if that does happen, we'll all work together to bring you back.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I promise.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Exactly. That's what I was going to say.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: ... All right. I'll trust you.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I'm guessing you feel something strange in your core every time you use your power. It feels hot, like something is about to go wrong, right?

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: It's okay. You're not overheating. What you're feeling is just the result of your energy output having grown so much.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Once you get used to it, it won't even feel hot anymore.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: All right. I'll give it a try, then.
Dorothy concentrates and aims her gun at the statue.
She feels her core growing hot. This uneasy, unfamiliar sensation was what made her hesitate.
Marian looks at Dorothy and silently nods her head.
Feeling certain, Dorothy pulls the trigger.
At least she tries to.
*Pshoo! Pshoo! Pshoo!*

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: What the...?
A cloud of smoke spews from the statue's back together with multiple flashes.
The smoke quickly rises into the air, spreading ever larger.

lines.speaker: sora_op_r
lines.text: *Gasp!* Multiple Annihilio signatures confirmed!

lines.speaker: cielo_op_l
lines.text: In total...

lines.speaker: cielo_op_l
lines.text: ... there appear to be about fifty of them.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Contact the Ark before... Damn it, the signal's jammed, isn't it?!

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: I'll take out at least one!

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I'll help!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Here we go!
The three of them turn and look into the air. They see dozens of flashing lights.
Just as they point their guns and hands in that direction...

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Oh, you've got to be kidding me.
A sound starts to ring through the sky...
... and red light starts gathering at the statue's neck.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Do something about that first. We'll let the Ark deal with the missiles.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: But if all of those hit their mark, the Ark is done for.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: And if that thing manages to fire its laser again, the Ark is still done for.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Quickly now.
They attack the statue's neck. The red light disperses.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I'll go. I might let a few through, but if I just create a synthetic world...

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: I don't know what that is, but let them go. It's your spears that are slowing down that thing's attacks.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: If you leave, the ship and Rapunzel won't be able to keep up.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Look, there's no need to worry.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: This is the kind of moment when a hero appears.
... Uh oh.
We watch dozens of lights fly toward the Ark, smoke spewing behind them.
Annihilios... And a lot of them, at that...
This time, they're not just flying in a vertical line. They're flying in an arc through the air.
I look at Rapi and Crown.
They're completely focused on battling the Nayutas. They clearly don't have time to deal with this.
Does the Ark have the forces to protect against those things? If not...
*Beeeee*
A familiar sound rings in the air.
*Beeeee*
The same sound overlaps multiple times.
I look up to the sky off in the distance.
I see an enormous whale gleaming in a pale blue light,
along with numerous whales following behind it,
all headed in the direction of the missile rain.
Friend!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: That's a lot of missiles!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Annihilios spotted up ahead! They're almost within range!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Great! Let's blow 'em to bits!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Get ready!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Let me get... this...!
Raptilion opens a compartment on the floor and pulls out a long, thick electrical cable.
He hands it to Maxwell.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Here. This cable is connected directly to Whaley's core.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Whaley's got plenty of energy, so use as much as you need.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Okay, thanks.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Connecting a Rapture's core to ours would be overly dangerous,

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: but I'll slap a converter on and attach it to my weapon.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: Hm? Why's it dangerous?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Because the energy sources are different. It would be like... I don't know... mixing blood or something.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: Raptures don't have blood.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Yeah, I know that, but um... Anyway, it's dangerous, so we can't.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: But they're both energy cores, right? What's so dangerous about it?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: They may look similar, but that doesn't mean they're the same. At any rate, thanks for this.
Maxwell hooks up the cable to a converter. She attaches the cables coming from the converter to everyone's weapons.
*Vwoooom*

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Ooh. I've never heard that sound before.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Hehe. I've heard it before. Long ago.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Huh? And when exactly was that?

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Uh, um... Look, what matters is that I heard it.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: From now on, we're going to pull all our energy from Whaley.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: With a Mother Whale of her size, we won't have to worry about running out of energy.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: But you do have to make sure your weapons don't overheat.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: We can cool them with water, right? That one time there were those sprinklers, and we didn't have any trouble!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Fool! You can't put a machine in water! You must blow on it to cool it down!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: ... Do whatever you want.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Haha! You three always have so much fun!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: The danger of the situation has made them a little more unhinged than usual.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Anyway, thanks for the ride, Raptilion. Your timing was impeccable.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: No need to thank me! We're friends!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: And I can't exactly ignore what's going on here.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: The Queen is trying to kill everything she didn't create.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: That's the complete opposite of living together in harmony!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: That's why I wanted to do what I could!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Thanks! This is a huge help!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Yeah. By the way, how did you get all those Mother Whales to come with you?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I convinced them!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: ... Right. Of course. I guess that's not too surprising.
Raptilion sees the dozens of shining lights in the distance.
Then he looks at Pinocchio beside him, who's staring in a daze at the horizon with the other Raptures.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: What's up, Pinocchio?

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: Uncle.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: Am I a Rapture?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: You're Pinocchio!

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: What about you?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I'm a friend to you and Raptures!

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: Uncle...

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: Among everyone that's gathered here,

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: there's nothing else like me.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: Raptures working with Raptures, Nikkes with Nikkes, humans with humans...

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: They're all working with their own kind to fight for a common goal.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: But I don't have anyone else of my kind, so I don't know what to do.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: Uncle, what am I?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: You're Pinocchio!

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: Ugh...! You didn't listen to a single word I said!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Pinocchio, it doesn't matter what you look like on the outside.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Your appearance is just a vessel for your heart.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: You don't need to agonize over it.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: Then you take off that Rapture suit.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: If appearance doesn't matter, then you don't need that suit, right?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Pinocchio... That's not...

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: See? You're scared too. Without your Rapture suit, you're human.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: You wear that suit because if you take it off, your friends here will either attack or ignore you.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: You're a liar.

lines.speaker: pinocchio
lines.text: You're trying to tell me that appearances don't matter when you're too scared to take off your suit.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Pinocchio...
Pinocchio turns and starts to stare again at the scene ahead.
Raptilion watches her while fidgeting nervously.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: What's going on with her?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Friend, if I took off my Rapture suit, what do you think would happen to me?
Maxwell looks at the Raptures casually moving around them.
They look as docile as regular animals. However...

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: ... *Sigh* I couldn't tell you. I have no idea.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Right? Neither do I.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: You, uh... You're a bit beyond my comprehension in more ways than one, so I'm afraid I can't be of any help.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: That's okay. Don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Oh, Whaley sent the signal.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: You can get started!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Oh! Get ready, Matis!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: I was waiting to hear that!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Time to jump into action!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Whaley!
*Beeeee*
Whaley opens her mouth and emits a shockwave.
*Beeeee*
The Mother Whales behind her do the same.
The air fills with the whales' chorus.
The Annihilios wobble and slow down.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Here we go! Let's show 'em our full power!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Great! Electric power, fully full charge!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Super duper overdrive!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Matis UberBuster!
Enormous beams of light sweep the formation of missiles.
Giant explosions color the sky.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Don't stop! Keep going!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Of course! I had no intention of stopping!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Hahaha! This is incredible! The energy just keeps coming!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Let's gooooo!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Don't boss me arooooound!
Three beams in different colors paint the sky once again.
The dazzling festival of lights and explosions catches the eye of everyone on the battlefield.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: ... Our heroes have arrived.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Matis?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Yeah. They really are incredible. Just look at that. Can you still even call them Nikkes?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: I can't wait for that thing to see its precious missiles getting blasted to pieces and...
*Pshoo! Pshoo! Pshoo!*

lines.speaker: sora_op_r
lines.text: Twenty additional Annihilios have been launched.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Unbelievable. How is that even possible?

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: ... The scale of its internal production facilities must be staggering.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Using the Lift as an energy source and with all of that Dark Matter, it can produce as much as it wants.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Which means this is a war of attrition. It's playing it safe, that coward.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: When do you think it'll run out of energy?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Huh, I see. In other words, we might be screwed.
I can't take my eyes off what's happening in the sky.
Whaley and the Mother Whales behind her.
Matis blasting away on Whaley's back.
The rain of missiles flying toward the Ark is decreasing bit by bit.
But then the Goddess of Victory statue fires more Annihilios.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... There's no end to them. We won't be able to win if this becomes a war of attrition.
Rapi talks beside me, her voice tired after having carved her way through the swarm of Nayutas to my side.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'm going to cool off for a moment. Those clones may not be moving much, but there were just so many of them.
How many are left?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: We'll be done soon.
Rapi activates her drill again and flies off. I look at Crown and Chime.
They're still running around on Trombe's back.
The number of Nayutas has drastically decreased.
It's a strange sight.
The Nayutas that once covered the ground are gone,
disappeared without a trace, as though they were never there to begin with.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Commander! I finished giving them first aid!

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: I'm gonna join in!
Are you okay with that?

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Huh? O-okay with what?
They may not be fighting back, but your opponents are still Nikkes.
Are you okay with shooting and destroying them?

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: I-I mean, Rapi and Crown are...
Look at their faces.
T.A.L.O.S. raises its head.
It looks at the faces of Rapi, Crown, and Chime as they cut through the swarm.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Scanning the expressions of all combatants.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Their faces show 50% conflict, 30% sadness, and 20% fear.
T.A.L.O.S.'s head turns back to me.
I probably have the same expression on my face.
They're only doing it because they have no choice.
You know Nayuta, don't you?

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Yeah...
It's not at all easy to kill someone with a familiar face.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Still, I'm going to help, since this is something that needs to be done.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Calculating.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: You've grown, Kilo. That's very admirable of you.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Y-you're embarrassing me.
... Okay, I appreciate your willingness. Just don't push yourself, okay?

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: I won't!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: It's all right. There's no need for Kilo and T.A.L.O.S. to get involved.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: We cleaned up while you guys were dragging your feet.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: We're finished, Commander.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... The Nayutas have been wiped out.
I turn my gaze to the battlefield.
... There's no one there.
I wipe the cold sweat from Rapi's forehead.
... Thanks for taking care of that.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... Yeah.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: ... You did good, everyone.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: ... Hmph. It was nothing.
Chime organizes her explosives pouch.
Her hands are trembling.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: T.A.L.O.S., help Chime organize her things.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Yeah... I could use some help. Thanks.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Now, where should we go next?
Let's keep going toward the statue.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I'd like to hear your reasoning for that.
I can't say for sure, but Nayuta is still out there, isn't she?

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Well... I would think so. She is able to create clones of herself, which is what we just fought.
Which means the real Nayuta is still out there.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Indeed.
I'm pretty sure she's inside the Goddess of Victory.
The clones came from there, and when they died, that is where their particles flew off to.
Assuming the clones are made to return those particles to her when they die...
then that's where she'll be.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: ... Your reasoning is sound.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I believe you're right.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: And assuming you are, she must be plotting something in there.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Which makes heading toward the statue our best choice, so long as Nayuta pulls through with whatever she's planning.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Do you think she will?

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Yes, I believe that too.
Good. Let's get going then.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Let's.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I must say, it's impressive how you managed to ascertain Nayuta's ability like that.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: You really should serve as the advisor to the Crown Kingdom.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Oh, I agree. We wouldn't have you serve in any other position. I imagine you don't have the talent for anything else.
Why did that suddenly turn into an insult...?

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Kilo, T.A.L.O.S. Please take the fine people from the train and retreat.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Go to the Ark and ask for help.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Oh... Um. I actually ran away from the Ark...

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Don't worry. Tell them proudly that you're a citizen of the Crown Kingdom now.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: I... somehow doubt that'll change much, but okay.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: I'm sure it'll all work out.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: You've grown bolder, Kilo. I applaud you.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Those two must've rubbed off on me a little.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: ... You know, it's a shame that we can't join in the battle, but I guess we wouldn't be much help.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: If you'd only given me golden arms, we could have done great things.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Can we not talk about that anymore? I'm sorry, okay?

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Thank you for your assistance.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: The battlefield may be taking shape over there, but you never know what might happen, and where.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Be especially careful.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Yeah. Will do.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Best of luck, everyone. Let's go, T.A.L.O.S.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Roger that.
Kilo and T.A.L.O.S. take Brid, Diesel, and Soline and begin to move.
Crown pulls on Trombe's reins.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Get on, everyone. Four is a bit much, but it's faster than running.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander, get on behind me. You'll have to hold tightly to my waist.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: And don't worry; I'll pretend not to notice if your hands slide up a bit, so long as it's not very much.
Okay...
With all of us on its back, Trombe sprints forward.
We start getting closer to the Goddess of Victory statue.
Mirror watches Nayuta as she operates the machine.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: ... I can't believe it.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Your clones are useless.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Why make two thousand of something so weak? That same time and resources would've been better spent making Raptures.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I had hoped you would actually do something, but that was...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: *Sigh...* Forget it. So long as you have the materials, you can make as many as you'd like, right?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Next time, make them self-destruct. That'll be far more useful.
Nayuta silently works the machine.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: ... Uselessness aside, it's still impressive.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Copying your NIMPH that many times, I mean.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: And when a clone with your NIMPH is destroyed, their NIMPH comes back to you.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Granted, that's also how you ended up like this, since the process is all automated.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Of course, you also never would've become corrupted if you hadn't divided up your NIMPH,

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: given the sheer volume of it.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: To put it another way, you actually need to have clones.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Otherwise, you'd have to bear the burden of that NIMPH by yourself, which would be impossible.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: It would destroy your mind, unless you had uncanny mental fortitude and an unyielding sense of self.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: However, even with its downsides, it's a spectacular technique.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I took a look inside you in the hopes of understanding how it works, but all I found was a black box that even I couldn't penetrate.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: How did you acquire that technology?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: ... I am quite sure there was nothing left in that lab.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: ... No matter. Once this fight is over, I will open you up and carefully examine what's inside.
Red particles float and swirl in the dark space.
Mirror traces their paths with her eyes.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Oh, it seems the NIMPH has returned from your final clone, no doubt the result of a pathetic death.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: It's such a pretty red.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Now take it back and quickly make more Nayutas.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Also, in addition to a self-destruct mechanism, I want you to give them... hm... corruption rods.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: We can't rely on their combat abilities, so let's at least give the Ark a good scare.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: In the end, it is the Queen who will kill them all anyway.
The red particles slowly fly toward Nayuta, where she stands operating the machine.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: You should be grateful that the Queen makes Raptures out of Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: If she didn't, we never would've wasted the materials from the Lift to make so many of you.
The red particles go inside Nayuta's body.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Now, get back to work.
Nayuta narrows her eyes. Suddenly...
*Flash!*
Light shines forth from her body.
It causes Mirror's sensors to malfunction. Her vision is frozen.
As the light fades, Mirror's vision steadily recovers.
She sees the monk staring at her indifferently.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: ... Huh?
Nayuta thrusts her palm forward.
*Boom!*
A shockwave strikes the wall, leaving a hand-shaped hole in its wake.
Explosions burst everywhere from the hole.
Nayuta stands with the explosions behind her and looks at Mirror.

lines.speaker: nayuta_a
lines.text: What dost thou look on?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: How did you...?

lines.speaker: nayuta_a
lines.text: I shall not say.
Nayuta continues to swing her palm.
Shockwaves ring out and explosions burst as she destroys machine after machine.
Nayuta continues to swing her palm.
She swings and swings as if taking out her pent-up anger.
